items.title: 5.2.3 Measures of Dispersion (Variance; 5.2.3.2 Standard Deviation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of variance and standard deviation (PDF 129-132).

blocks.text: Phailao (dispersion) ke paimane batate hain ke data kitna phaila hai. Variance qeematon ka mean se murabba faasle ka ausat hai: variance = (1/N) x (xi - mean)^2 ka jama, jahan xi har qeemat, mean ko mu likhte hain aur N qeematon ki tadaad hai. Standard deviation variance ka square root hai, data ki ikaiyon mein.

blocks.caption: Ek hi exam par do classes

blocks.text: Class A: mean 274 / 5 = 54.8, variance 62.8 / 5 = 12.56, standard deviation taqreeban 3.54. Class B: mean 295 / 5 = 59, variance 2270 / 5 = 454, standard deviation taqreeban 21.31. Class B ke scores kahin zyada phaile hain, jabke Class A ke mean ke gird qareeb qareeb hain.

blocks.alt: Ek hi number line par do qataarein: Class A ke scores 50, 52, 55, 57, 60 qareeb qareeb (mean 54.8), aur Class B ke scores 30, 45, 55, 75, 90 door door phaile hue (mean 59).
blocks.caption: Class A aur Class B ke scores ka phailao ek number line par (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: homework ke ghante 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18 ka mean, median, mode, variance aur standard deviation nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Mean 110 / 10 = 11; median (10 + 12) / 2 = 11; modes 8 aur 15; murabba farq 64, 36, 9, 9, 1, 1, 16, 16, 25, 49 ka jama 226, to variance 22.6 aur standard deviation taqreeban 4.75. Zyada students taqreeban 11 ghante lagate hain, magar aadat dono taraf taqreeban 5 ghante badalti hai.

items: Variance: murabba farq ka ausat; SD: us ka square root. Class A 12.56 aur 3.54; Class B 454 aur 21.31.
